evidence_summary: New validation results: 8 result files covering dense embeddings (12,570 decisions, years 2000-2002), 3 citation-role modes (1,200 decisions), 4 outcome-hybrid modes (1,200 decisions), and outcome_tfidf negative control. All use frozen config (coarse_res=0.25/0.5, base_sub_res=3.0, min_cluster_size=10, max_subclusters=20, adaptive_sub_res=true). Zero leakage: configs frozen, v26 rule applied consistently, all modes tested, negative results preserved. Key finding: constrained hierarchical Leiden solves fragmentation (0% singletons) and guarantees nesting (1.0) at all tested scales. Citation-role modes: 60-75% improvement rate. Outcome-hybrid modes: 71-86% improvement rate. Dense embeddings: 45.5% improvement rate (below 50% threshold), strong area purity gain +10%. TF-IDF 174k: 0/4 modes PASS (confirmed FAIL). State file overclaims COMPLETE/REPRODUCED; actual evidence tier is EXPLORATORY with blockade intact.
